residual.wall: Live GGX is isotropic. One α. Highlights are round. Stretch, gait, and the W do not streak the spec. Dual: isotropic-blob = stretched-fiber-highlight.

question: What is a lawful anisotropic reflection on a dielectric gel cage, where do T and B come from, and when must Gasper stay isotropic?
coordinateSpaces: Cage φ: rings×sectors xyz. Tangent T = ∂P/∂u (sector, wraps). Bitangent B = ∂P/∂v (ring, clamps). n̂ = T×B. View V=(0,0,1). Lights L_k view-fixed. H = normalize(L+V). h_x=H·T, h_y=H·B, h_z=H·n. Intensity-only. FACE_CANON off this organ.
physicalLaw: Isotropic D(h) depends only on n·h. Anisotropic D depends on the azimuth of h in the tangent frame: different α along T vs B.
Disney / Burley 2012 anisotropic GGX (GTR2): aspect = √(1−0.9 a), αx = r²/aspect, αy = r²·aspect. D = (1/(π αx αy)) · 1 / ((hx/αx)² + (hy/αy)² + hz²)².
Smith G must use the same αx, αy (Heitz 2014). Mixing isotropic G with anisotropic D leaks energy.
Ashikhmin–Shirley 2000: anisotropic Phong + Fresnel-weighted diffuse. Ancestor. Disney replaced D with GGX for the long tail.
Ward: older Gaussian ellipse. Not the production close.
Kajiya–Kay / Chiang hair: longitudinal/azimuthal lobes for fibers. Wrong material. Gasper is gel, not hair.
Heitz stretch: a stretched surface inherits anisotropy from the 2D Jacobian of φ. Rest isotropic + stretch → live anisotropic. That is the organism, not a slider.
Pole of a polar cage: T vanishes at v=0. Aniso must clamp to 0 near the pole or T is noise.
artisticLaw: Rest pearl is isotropic. Round glint. Aniso at rest is a fail.
Stretch (W legs, run, pinch, paddle handle) may streak along the stretch, not along a painted KEY_ANCHOR.
Intensity-only. No new hue. metalness stays 0. F0 = 0.04.
Clearcoat stays isotropic (gel skin). Base lobe may aniso. Two lobes, two laws.
FACE_CANON untouched. Face is not a brushed plate.
Explore does not recut the painter.

tests: Rest pearl: αx=αy. Rotating yaw keeps the glint round.
Stretch T 2×: highlight elongates along T. Peak drops.
Pole: v<0.08 aniso == 0 even if the body is stretched.
T,B orthonormal after n rebuild. n·T = n·B = 0.
visualConsequences: Rest: a round crawling glint. Same as now, if aniso=0.
Run / W: spec streaks along the pulled meridians, not a parked brow slash.
Paddle handle: a thin highlight along the shaft.
Pinch: a short streak across the waist.
Turntable: the streak rides φ, not the screen.
implementation: Explore only. Do not recut the painter this receipt.
If Work: keep isotropic GGX as the a=0 path (byte-identical).
Build T=normalize(∂P/∂u), B=normalize(n×T) from the same stencil as n̂.
a from stretch: a = saturate( |ℓ_T / ℓ_T0 − ℓ_B / ℓ_B0| ). Rest → 0.
Disney αx, αy. Aniso D + matching Smith. Coat stays iso.
Do not revive KEY_ANCHORS. Do not add a hair BSDF. Do not add metallic.
